svg.aria-label: Per-thread busy time — interleaved rows — View 1
svg.text: Per-thread busy time — interleaved rows — View 1
Each bar is the time one thread spends computing its strided rows (r, r+T, r+2T, ...).
Wall time is bounded below by the tallest bar; shorter bars are idle capacity. Fastest of 5 runs per process, best of 3 processes.
Source: results/interleaved — fastest of 5 runs per process, best of 3 processes.
